title: A Autopsy for the Verdict
author: Lior Pemberton
blurb: Jonah Okonkwo, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, has spent seven years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
